query: What is the refund policy for annual subscriptions?

segments.history: Hi there, how are you today? I hope you are having a wonderful day. I wanted to reach out because I have been a customer for about two years now. I recently upgraded to an annual plan last month and I am not entirely sure it was the right decision for me. I was wondering if there is any way to get a refund or switch back to monthly billing. I tried looking on the website but could not find a clear answer. The FAQ page just had generic information. I also called the support line but was on hold for 20 minutes and had to hang up. Anyway, I just want to understand my options before I make any decisions. Thank you so much for your help. I really appreciate it.
segments.docs: Refund and Cancellation Policy. Effective Date: January 1, 2024. This policy governs all subscription plans offered by Example Corp. Monthly Subscriptions: Monthly plans are billed at the start of each billing cycle. Refunds are not available for monthly plans once the billing cycle has started. You may cancel a monthly subscription at any time and your access will continue until the end of the current billing period. Annual Subscriptions: Customers who purchase annual subscription plans are eligible for a full refund if the refund request is submitted within 30 days of the initial purchase date. After the 30-day window, refunds are calculated on a prorated basis: the refund amount equals the unused portion of the subscription, minus a 10% administrative fee. To request a refund, customers must contact our support team at support@example.com or through the in-app Help Centre. Refund requests are processed within 5 business days. Enterprise Plans: Enterprise agreements are governed by separate contractual terms and are not subject to this standard refund policy. For questions about enterprise refunds, contact your account manager. General Provisions: Example Corp reserves the right to modify this refund policy at any time. Changes will be communicated via email to registered account holders at least 14 days in advance.
